# AgroVision v2 dataset card (auto-generated by ml/build_dataset.py)

Leaf corpus: **188,146 images, 223 classes, 38 crops** (+ 'not a plant' and 'insect' router classes). Pest corpus (IP102): **71,965 images, 102 species**.

Split: stratified by class, grouped by near-duplicate cluster (256-bit dHash, Hamming <= 10, within source+class) and PlantVillage leaf id; seed 42. Images stored at 256 px short side.
